summary: FURNISHED DOUBLE ROOM IN PROFESSIONAL SHARED HOUSE My Property Box are pleased to bring to the market this newly renovated, furnished double room in a six bedroom shared house of professionals. This large double bedroom is located on the second floor, comes fully furnished and includes all bills. Also includes Council Tax. The property itself is in the town centre and has great transport links. Property comprises of: Furnished Double Bedroom, Shared Bathroom, Shared Lounge, Shared Fully Fitted Kitchen.
